dz: 征服库查:由唐朝将领阿希那·舍尔率领的四十天围攻后,库查出兵投降,建立唐人对新疆北部塔里木盆地的控制.
de: Conquest of Kucha: The forces of Kucha surrender after a forty-day siege led by Tang dynasty general Ashina She'er, establishing Tang control over the northern Tarim Basin in Xinjiang.
